And after Gainas the rebel perished,
the Huns crossed the river Ister (Danube).
And when they took captives and devastated cities in Thrace,
hail descended upon them
and killed the majority of them,
and the rest fled.
And after these things Arcadius died,
and he left Theodosius his son, a small boy eight years old, as king.
And Honorius, moreover, had no children.
And since they had only this one,
they feared for him lest some people deal treacherously with him.
Therefore, when this Arcadius died, he made a will,
and made Yazdegerd, king of the Persians, the guardian (curator) of his son.
Now that Yazdegerd, when he received the will,
zealously cared for Theodosius.
And he sent a tutor from his presence,
and wrote to the entire Senate
that if {OCR?} they dealt treacherously with the boy,
an unappeasable war would come upon them from him.
And for this reason, Christianity grew great among the Persians,
while Marutha, bishop of Maypherqat, mediated between them.
Now Theodosius and his sister Pulcheria were being brought up with their uncle Honorius.
After Arcadius, Theodosius the Younger, his son, [ruled] forty-two years.
At the beginning of his reign, a certain African man, Alaric, rebelled,
and he gathered an army and came to Italy,
and wrought many evils.
And Stilicho the consul was also killed.
And King Honorius died in Rome.
And Constantius, the father of Valentinian the Third {OCR?}, became king and was killed.
And John, one of the scribes, seized the kingdom,
and sent to Theodosius to confirm him in it.
The king, however, when he had imprisoned the envoys,
sent the general Ardaburius against him, the tyrant.
The tyrant, however, was victorious,
and he captured the general and imprisoned him.
And again Theodosius sent Aspar, the son of Ardaburius, and with him an army.
And through the prayers of the God-fearing king,
an angel appeared in the likeness of a shepherd
and led them across the lake of water on foot.
And they found the gates of the city open and entered it,
and they brought out the general who had been imprisoned,
and killed the tyrant John.
